envelope.description: Run the validation hook on both resolution paths with the expected repository

body.title: Run the validation hook on both resolution paths with the expected repository
body.summary: Give stepScope and prepareScope an optional expectedRepo argument that calls validateRequestScope after resolution; the step start passes the resolved repository, plan and narrow pass the state's repoPath; oneShotRunParams returns expectedRepo and the daemon's buildRun passes it to prepareScope, so start, plan, narrow and the one-shot run refuse an invalid scope before any read.
acceptanceChecks: the real step handlers refuse an invalid scope at start, plan and narrow
the real one-shot handler refuses an invalid scope before any read
a '..' path that enters another registered repository is refused through both real handlers, comparing the canonical path

tests.name: start-request.test.ts: the real start, plan and narrow handlers refuse a nonexistent path, a wrong path kind, a '..' path into another repository and a repository mismatch
analyze-oneshot-handler.test.ts: the real one-shot handler and buildRun refuse the same invalid scopes through prepareScope with the repository from oneShotRunParams
